Oracle Fusion Procurement 26C: what changed

We track 25 Procurement changes in 26C, out of 71 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Then one plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs. Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Read issue #1 (26C) → · Privacy

Oracle sources: Procurement 26C What's New · Self Service Procurement 26C What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Former opt-ins now standard in 26C

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list: features whose opt-in period ended with 26C. If you already opted in and finished setup, nothing changes. All former opt-ins now standard in 26C →

Delivered switched on (25)

Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Supply Chain Orchestration
Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Cancel an Approved Work Confirmation as a Buyer

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform Idea Lab
Cancel approved work confirmations as a buyer. Before this update, you couldn't cancel approved work confirmations.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Edit Charge Account Segments on Multiple Purchase Order Schedules

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Select multiple schedules and edit the cost center and natural account segments directly from the Purchase Orders page. You can choose to split partially delivered or billed distributions, and the application will update the segments on the new distribution for the unprocessed remainder.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Selected Purchasing Bug Fixes in This Update

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Purchasing
Oracle's list of 26C Purchasing fixes that change behavior. The main one: with profile option ORA_PO_CO_BUDGET_DATE_FOR_LIQ set to Y, funds on change orders are now liquidated on the budget date, the change order date or the current date, depending on dates and fulfillment. Others include global DFFs on Approved Supplier List documents and back-arrow navigation on Redwood pages.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Selected Sourcing Bug Fixes in This Update

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Sourcing
Fix: in Redwood, a negotiation created from a template now uses the latest version of its negotiation style, so style changes made after the template was created now apply.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Supply Chain Orchestration
Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AI Agent: Negotiation Surrogate Response Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · SourcingAI agent
Deploy the Surrogate Response Assistant to automate creation of supplier negotiation responses. This new AI Agent template enables category managers to create surrogate responses from supplier response documents received in email.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Create Transfer Orders with Header Level Descriptive Flexfields

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Supply Chain Orchestration
Use the Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration Supply Requests REST API and the Supply Order Import FBDI template to create transfer orders with header level descriptive flexfields.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood: Communicate Purchase Agreements to Multiple Email Recipients

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Add multiple email recipients when communicating purchase agreements to suppliers. You can now notify internal stakeholders and additional supplier contacts through the same email sent when a new purchase agreement or change order is issued.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Review B2B Account Number on Purchasing Documents

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform Idea Lab
Review the B2B account number associated with a supplier on purchasing documents using Redwood purchasing pages. Use the supplier information drawer to review the B2B account number when viewing a purchasing document.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: Use Extensibility Capabilities to Default Document Styles When Creating Purchasing Documents

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Use extensibility capabilities to set a default document style when creating purchasing documents using the Redwood experience. You can now define a default document style for the New purchase order and New agreement drawers, as well as for staged documents.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood: View Additional Information About Location and Supplier

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
View additional information about supplier, ship-to location, bill-to location, and deliver-to location when viewing purchase orders and purchase agreements using a Redwood page.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Selected External Purchase Prices Bug Fixes in This Update

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · External Purchase Prices
External Purchase Prices FBDI templates now work on Mac as well as Windows. Oracle lists this among the 26C bug fixes that change behavior.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

View Additional Information About Preparers, Requesters, Buyers, and Approvers

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform Idea Lab
You can now view additional information about the preparers, requesters, buyers, and approvers on requisitions and purchase orders. In addition to details such as name, job title, manager name, and department, you can also view contact information such as email, work phone, and work address.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Access Cart Details Directly During Requisition Creation

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
You can now access shopping cart details directly while creating a requisition, which improves visibility and makes navigation easier during the request creation process.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Create a Noncatalog Request Without Copying Supplier Details From a Previous Request

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
After you submit a noncatalog or smart form request, the confirmation message now offers Create another request (starting fresh) alongside Create another request with the same supplier. The View cart link moves to the navigation bar at the bottom of the page.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Identify Attachments and Notes on My Requisitions

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
The note and attachment icons that 26B added to requisition lines now also appear on the My Requisitions page.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Launch Quote to Purchase Requisition Assistant from Menu

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
The Quote to Purchase Requisition Assistant, which turns emailed supplier quotes into requisitions, can now be started from the Self Service Procurement home page menu, without setting up an email account. You still need to create and publish an instance of the agent in AI Agent Studio.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage Public Shopping Lists

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
Catalog administrators can now manage public shopping lists using a Redwood experience. After opting into this feature, you can access the Redwood Public Shopping Lists page from the quick links under Catalogs.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage Shopping Catalog Category Hierarchies

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
Manage shopping catalog category hierarchies using a Redwood page to create, manage, and reorganize procurement catalog categories for browsing and shopping. You can access the Shopping Catalog Category Hierarchy page from the quick links under Catalogs.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Search for Deliver-to Locations Using Additional Attributes in Requisitions

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
The enhanced deliver-to location search (by name, code, address, city, postal code or country) now works on the requisition line and summary edit pages, not just in Preferences. It's off by default and switched on with a Visual Builder Studio constant.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Selected Self Service Procurement Bug Fixes in This Update

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service Procurement
Fix: charge account combination details are easier to review in requisitions, from the charge account actions menu in edit mode or the account link in read-only mode.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Sort Shopping Search Results and Shopping Lists by Item Number and Supplier Item

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
Sort shopping search results by item number and supplier item. This feature is also available for shopping lists.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

View Additional Information About Deliver-to Locations

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
You can now view additional information about the deliver-to location on a requisition line, including the address of the location and location code. To use this feature, use the link for the deliver-to location when viewing a requisition line.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source
